scenes.description: Wide cinematic shot of all six heroes on a muddy forest road at dusk, caught in an ambush: goblins leap out of the bushes and a snarling dire wolf charges from the left. Bran and Grukk are at the front, Sylvaine draws her bow, Pip is crouched with her rapier, Hilda raises her shield and Ambrine casts a spell with her glowing staff. Misty pine forest, low orange light.

Three heroes in a crumbling stone crypt lit by torches and a sickly green glow: Bran holds the line with his shield, Hilda's mace glows with golden light against the undead, Ambrine reads from her spellbook. Skeletons claw their way out of open sarcophagi in the background. Dust, cobwebs, broken pillars.

Intimate tavern scene lit by candles: Pip leans over a worn wooden table, talking in a low voice to a hooded stranger seen from behind, a half-finished mug in front of her, a suspicious innkeeper in the background wiping a glass. Warm amber light, smoke, wooden beams.
Portrait of the monster, waist-up, snarling at the viewer, torchlit cave background with a hint of bones and stolen loot.

Wide establishing shot, no people in the foreground. A village of black ash-stained slate roofs huddled around a runed dwarven stone tower whose summit casts a faint orange glow. A log palisade, narrow lanes full of grey snow, candle-lit windows, creeping smoke, cold mist and blue shadows in the valley.

Wide shot, no people. A lichen-covered grey stone portico at the end of a snowy graveyard, a verdigris bronze door ajar on a black staircase, grey ash piling in drifts against the gravestones, dim cold light.

Wide shot, no people. A hollow mountain of perfectly symmetrical galleries: basalt colonnes, iron ramps, frozen molten-metal channels, colossal statues, iron-bowl street lamps, giant cogwheels the size of houses set into the walls, dwarven runes blackened by soot.
